caption:
Buy a house. Get your cash back. That's BRRRR: buy, rehab, rent, refinance, repeat.

Example:
Buy $150,000 + rehab $40,000 = $190,000 all-in
After-repair value $260,000 × 75% refinance = $195,000 new loan
That repays what you put in (before closing costs), so your cash is free for the next deal.

The catch: it only works if the after-repair value is real. Overpay or overspend and your cash stays stuck. Lenders also have seasoning rules and rates that change the math.
